sloka: बहवः शत्रवश्चापि संयुगेषु निपातिताः।त्रिषु लोकेषु रत्नानि भुङ्क्ते चाहृत्य रावणः ।। ६.९३.४३ ।।
transliteration: bahavaḥ śatravaścāpi saṁyugeṣu nipātitāḥ।triṣu lokeṣu ratnāni bhuṅkte cāhṛtya rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.93.43 ।।

translations.english: "Ravana has collected gems from the three worlds as tax. There is none equal to him in might and prowess in this world."
